extracted.name: Banana daiquiri
extracted.description: Bring sunshine to your cocktail repertoire in the form of a punchy, fun banana daiquiri. Garnish with banana slices, lime wedges or cocktail cherries
ingredient_lines: banana slices or banana chips, lime wedges or cocktail cherries, to garnish (optional)
instruction_lines: Put the rum, banana liqueur, lime juice, banana and ice in a blender suitable for crushing ice, and blitz until smooth.

Pour the drink into a hurricane or other tall glass, and garnish with banana slices or chips, lime wedges or cocktail cherries, if you like (we skewered two cocktail cherries and a lime wedge on a cocktail stick).
